findings.detail: Option B of M3-S23-T1 says that setting tool_choice to "any" means the model must call a tool on every turn. Its reason repeats that "any" only forces a tool call. This tells the reader the answer to M3-S28-T1, whose correct option is to set tool_choice to "any" to guarantee a tool call while the model still chooses the tool.

The same wrong idea appears as a wrong option in three questions: hand the case to a human through escalate_to_human instead of letting the agent handle it. M3-S19-T1 D escalates every multi-concern message. M3-S23-T1 A routes every routine account change through escalate_to_human. M3-S24-T1 C escalates at the first lookup_order timeout. The triggers differ, but each distractor offers unnecessary escalation as the safe fix, and two of the reasons give the same argument about first-contact resolution. Replace one of these distractors with a different misconception.
